name: Wikimedia Commons
notes: Asset-level license verification required; strong source for CC/public-domain exercise media.

name: YMove
notes: 25 free exercise videos advertise commercial use and direct download; full library has separate licensing/white-label terms.

name: ExerciseVideoAPI
notes: 290 HD white-label exercise videos with advertised perpetual commercial licence and download delivery. Verify final purchase terms before ingestion.

name: Fitter Stock
notes: Advertises 3,500+ exercise assets, 1,000+ videos and white-label/platform licensing.

name: Funxtion FXCONTENT
notes: Advertises 3,500+ exercises, 1,000+ workouts, 650+ virtual classes, REST API and SDK delivery.

name: WorkoutDB
notes: Paid Pro/Scale plans advertise commercial in-product use of first-party exercise media/data.

name: MuscleWiki API
notes: Commercial API intended for fitness/health products; redistribution, own API and competing dataset are prohibited. Prefer streaming/embedded delivery over mirroring.

name: ExerciseAPI
notes: Advertises exercise data under CC BY 4.0. Useful for metadata; media coverage is not assumed. Attribution required.

name: RepDB
notes: 601-exercise free snapshot with commercial in-app use and attribution. No dataset redistribution; premium animation previews excluded.

name: MoveKit
notes: 400+ exercise animations with commercial licensing; raw standalone redistribution prohibited.

name: Exercise Animatic
notes: Commercial/lifetime licensing is advertised for embedding exercise animations in apps and other products.

name: ExerciseClips
notes: Standard licence is not sufficient for building an app/platform; Extended Licence is required for that use case.

name: White Label Workouts
notes: Exercise demos/explainers marketed for apps, portals and coaching products under white-label terms.

name: Pexels Videos
notes: Commercial-use platform license exists, but asset/person/brand suitability and standalone redistribution restrictions must be checked per use.

name: Pixabay Videos
notes: Commercial-use platform license exists, but standalone redistribution and asset-specific conditions must be respected.

name: Mixkit
notes: Large workout/exercise stock-video catalogs; verify the exact asset licence before app ingestion.

name: Kinetic.place
notes: Large exercise catalog and premium video offering; free data claims do not imply premium-video redistribution rights.

name: ExerciseLibrary API
notes: Large exercise API with video links; delivery/caching/storage rights depend on API plan/terms.

name: Programme
notes: Useful embedding/licensing research lead; compiling a competing standalone library is constrained.

name: Gym visual derived datasets
notes: Public repos may contain Gym visual media with separate rights; repo MIT status must never be treated as a media licence.

name: CARAVAN Wellness Exercise API
notes: Advertises unbranded white-label wellness/exercise content, CDN-hosted video streaming, search/filtering and custom production.

name: Vital Animations
notes: Advertises 1,500+ exercise animations with lifetime commercial usage and self-hosted app delivery rights; raw dataset redistribution prohibited.

name: Exercise.com Exercise Library
notes: Exercise.com advertises a broad exercise library and custom-branded apps; exact rights for extracting/self-hosting prebuilt videos require direct platform/licence review.

name: Hyperhuman
notes: Exercise content platform with Content API, app/embed delivery and partner content; media rights vary by catalogue/plan and must be scoped.

name: White Label Fitness
notes: White-label fitness platform product with exercise library and training content; useful as a content/licensing benchmark, not an automatic media source.

name: Liaqa / ExerciseLibrary.com
notes: Liaqa publicly describes ownership of ExerciseLibrary.com and a white-label 1,000+ exercise demo system; exact asset delivery/licence requires direct review.

name: Free Exercise DB With Videos
notes: Repository openly warns that demo-video provenance is uncertain even though code/metadata are MIT; do not ingest media.

name: Gym Visual Exercise Dataset Forks
notes: Repository separates MIT code/data from Gym visual media and instructs users to obtain their own media licence.
